why_it_matters: The acquisition criteria shape which parcels the committee may later recommend for protection, so adding an underserved-areas test could affect where open space is sought in town.
The housing bylaws the planning board asked about govern how new development is laid out and how much open space it sets aside, and any change would go through the usual public bylaw process.
